008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011import paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog;
012import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
013
014import javax.swing.*;
015import javax.swing.border.EtchedBorder;
016import java.awt.*;
017import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
018import java.io.File;
019import java.nio.file.Path;
020import java.util.ArrayList;
021import java.util.Arrays;
022import java.util.Comparator;
023import java.util.List;
024
025import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
026
027public class ExperimentsPanel {
028
029    private final ProjectDialog.DialogMode dialogMode;
030    private final JPanel                   panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
031    private final JPanel                   list  = new JPanel();
032    private final List<AbstractButton>     boxes = new ArrayList<>();
033    private ButtonGroup                    group; // only used in TRACKMATE_SINGLE
034
035    private Runnable onChanged = () -> {};
036
037    /**
038     * Constructs an {@code ExperimentsPanel} and immediately loads the list of
039     * experiments from the given project root.
040     *
041     * @param projectRoot the root directory of the project
042     */
043    public ExperimentsPanel(Path projectRoot, ProjectDialog.DialogMode dialogMode) {
044
045        this.dialogMode = dialogMode;
046        list.setLayout(new BoxLayout(list, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
047
048        // Scrollable container for experiment checkboxes
049        JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(list);
050        scroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(680, 240));
051        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEtchedBorder(EtchedBorder.LOWERED));
052
053        // Top control bar (Select All / Clear All) for checkbox modes
054        if (dialogMode != ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
055            JPanel  controls  = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT));
056            JButton selectAll = new JButton("Select All");
057            JButton clearAll  = new JButton("Clear All");
058            controls.add(selectAll);
059            controls.add(clearAll);
060
061            selectAll.addActionListener(this::selectAllExperiments);
062            clearAll.addActionListener(this::clearAllExperiments);
063
064            panel.add(controls, BorderLayout.NORTH);
065        }
066
067        panel.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
068
069        // Initial load
070        reload(projectRoot);
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * Returns the main Swing component for this panel.
075     *
076     * @return the panel UI component
077     */
078    public JPanel component() {
079        return panel;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Registers a callback that is invoked whenever selection changes
084     * If the caller provides a non-null Runnable → use it.
085     * If the caller passes null → fall back to an empty no-op runnable, so your code never has to deal with a null callback.
086     *
087     * @param runnable a Runnable to invoke on selection change
088     */
089    public void onSelectionChanged(Runnable runnable) {
090        this.onChanged = (runnable != null ? runnable : () -> {});
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * Checks whether at least one experiment is selected.
095     * @return true if any checkbox is selected, false otherwise
096     */
097    public boolean anySelected() {
098        for (AbstractButton abstractButton : boxes) {
099            if (abstractButton.isSelected()) {
100                return true;
101            }
102        }
103        return false;
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Returns the names of all selected experiments.
108     *
109     * @return list of experiment names
110     */
111    public List<String> selectedExperimentNames() {
112
113        List<String> experimentNames = new ArrayList<>();
114        for (AbstractButton abstractButton : boxes) {
115            if (abstractButton.isSelected()) {
116                experimentNames.add(abstractButton.getText());
117            }
118        }
119        PaintLogger.debugf("ExperimentsPanel.selectedExperimentNames: %s", experimentNames);
120        return experimentNames;
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Enables or disables all experiment checkboxes.
125     *
126     * @param enabled whether the checkboxes should be enabled
127     */
128    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
129        for (AbstractButton abstractButton : boxes) {
130            abstractButton.setEnabled(enabled);
131        }
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Reloads and reconstructs the list of experiments from the given project
136     * root directory. Only subdirectories containing {@code ExperimentInfo.csv}
137     * (and not named "Sweep") are included.
138     *
139     * @param projectRoot the project root path
140     */
141    public void reload(Path projectRoot) {
142        list.removeAll();
143        boxes.clear();
144
145        // Create checkbox/radiobutton for the experiment
146        if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
147            group = new ButtonGroup();
148        } else {
149            group = null;
150        }
151
152        String  selectedExperiment       = null;
153        boolean singleExperimentSelected = false;
154
155        if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
156            selectedExperiment = PaintConfig.getString("Single TrackMate Mode", "SelectedExperiment", "");
157        }
158        // Scan subdirectories of the project root
159        File[] experimentDirectories = (projectRoot != null ? projectRoot.toFile().listFiles() : null);
160        if (experimentDirectories != null) {
161            Arrays.sort(experimentDirectories, Comparator.comparing(File::getName, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER));
162            for (File experimentDirectory : experimentDirectories) {
163                if (!experimentDirectory.isDirectory()) {
164                    continue;
165                }
166
167                // Experiment must contain ExperimentInfo.csv
168                File experimentInfofile = new File(experimentDirectory, EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
169                if (!experimentInfofile.isFile()) {
170                    continue;
171                }
172
173                if ("Sweep".equals(experimentDirectory.getName())) {
174                    continue;
175                }
176
177                final String experimentName = experimentDirectory.getName();
178
179                AbstractButton abstractButton;
180                if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
181                    abstractButton = new JRadioButton(experimentName);
182                    group.add(abstractButton);
183                } else {
184                    abstractButton = new JCheckBox(experimentName);
185                }
186
187                abstractButton.addActionListener(e -> {
188                    if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE && abstractButton.isSelected()) {
189                        PaintConfig.setString(
190                                "Single TrackMate Mode",
191                                "SelectedExperiment",
192                                experimentName
193                        );
194                    }
195                    onChanged.run();
196                });
197
198                if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
199                    if (experimentName.equals(selectedExperiment)) {
200                        abstractButton.setSelected(true);
201                        singleExperimentSelected = true;
202                    }
203                } else {
204                    boolean saved = PaintConfig.instance().getBooleanValueNoWarning("Experiments", experimentName, false);
205                    abstractButton.setSelected(saved);
206                }
207                boxes.add(abstractButton);
208                list.add(abstractButton);
209            }
210
211            if (dialogMode == ProjectDialog.DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
212                if (!singleExperimentSelected && !boxes.isEmpty()) {
213                    boxes.get(0).setSelected(true);
214                }
215            }
216        }
217
218        list.revalidate();
219        list.repaint();
220        onChanged.run();
221    }
222
223    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
224    private void selectAllExperiments(ActionEvent e) {
225        for (AbstractButton abstractButton : boxes) {
226            abstractButton.setSelected(true);
227        }
228        onChanged.run();
229    }
230
231    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
232    private void clearAllExperiments(ActionEvent e) {
233        for (AbstractButton abstractButton : boxes) {
234            abstractButton.setSelected(false);
235        }
236        onChanged.run();
237    }
238}
